verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a CLI-based IaC platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The DIY state backend and self-hosting options are adjacent features about where state is stored, not controls over usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
